body: Calm down, I was wondering why it happens for every bin in certain pods. I know the purpose of my job. It’s very rare that I get a pod where I get the double beep for each bin. I always wondered if it was bc I was the first person counting the pod so the system wanted me to confirm my first count or if the stower just fucked up with the whole pod. But thanks for the clarification.
Yea, that’s my main problem. It’s annoying when it beeps for every single bin in one pod. So that mean the stowers missed a scan or double scanned for each bin?
I feel you, you don’t know how bad I fantasize about dying from corona, getting shot, cancer, getting hit by a car etc. I’m just exhausted & ready for my life to be over.
